pages.title: Permanent Links
pages.text: A book is a door you carry. A $(thing)Crystal Portal$() is a door that agrees to stay put. $(br)$(br)Build a closed frame of $(c)Crystal Blocks$(). It may stand upright or lie flat, and it need not be a perfect rectangle, but the crystal must complete its ring.

pages.title: Ignition
pages.text: One stone of the frame must be a $(c)Book Receptacle$(). When the frame is sealed, place a proper Linking Book or Descriptive Book within it. If the frame approves, the passage wakes at once and takes on the hue of its destination.

Take away the book, or break the crystal ring, and the road collapses without ceremony. I have seen pursuers vanish mid-step this way. I have also seen friends do the same, so be certain before meddling.
